items.name: jacobian-lens-for-mac
items.description: Anthropic's Jacobian Lens, ported to Mac. The official reference implementation targets CUDA GPUs — this fork runs it on Apple silicon (PyTorch MPS) and adds a local interactive explorer for Qwen with plain-language interpretability demos and a live cause-and-effect intervention.
